messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up — planning a non-urgent deploy of feature/telemetry-routing at 18:30 UTC today. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4523 :clock630:
Dan: I'll own the deploy and rollback. Canary -> 10% for 15m, then promote if checks pass. I'm available during window.
Liam: I'll run smoke tests (end-to-end generation, embedding sanity) after canary. Ping me when canary finishes.
Sophia: I pushed a short Grafana patch to branch infra/telemetry-dash-4523. Added p99.5 latency panel and a trace sample panel for `kv_cache` hits. Dashboard link: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/telemetry
Ana: Heads-up on alerts: I'm proposing a temporary alert suppression for `HighTokenGenerationErrorRate` and relax threshold from 2%->3% for 10m during canary so we don't page on transient noise. See snippet:
```yaml
alerts:
  - id: HighTokenGenerationErrorRate
    threshold: 0.03
    window: 10m
    note: 'temporary relax for canary 1769938451'
```
Sophia: Also adding a short-lived trace sampling increase (1%->10%) for the canary to capture more traces for regression analysis.
Maya: Dan, please confirm rollback readiness (hotfix branch, db migrations none). Also we need the smoke checklist included in the PR description — can we add it now?
Dan: Rollback plan: `git revert -m 1 <merge-commit>`, rollout to canary config -> 0%. No db migrations. Hotfix branch exists: hotfix/telemetry-rollback-4523
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started at 1769938580 — 10% on pool `canary-telemetry` :rocket:
deploy-bot: Health checks passing on 5/5 canary instances. Latency baseline compared.
Liam: Canary complete — ran generation smoke test, avg latency +12ms p50, p99 unchanged. No functional regressions.
monitor-bot: Suppressed alert HighTokenGenerationErrorRate for 15m by Ana. Suppression ID: sup-9921
Sophia: Grafana panels reporting a small uptick in token errors (0.6%) under the threshold. Traces show one model variant with tokenization mismatch — filing a short issue: https://github.com/redwood/inference/issues/4567
Maya: OK promote to 100% at 1769938720. Dan take it away.
Dan: Promoting now, will watch smoke targets for 20m. If error rate >1.5% or latency p99 rises >200ms we rollback.
deploy-bot: Promotion to 100% complete at 1769938790 — all regions.
Liam: Quick post-deploy check done, embedding drift within expected bounds. :thumbsup:
Ana: Removing suppression now. Monitor rules back to normal.
Maya: Thanks team. I'll drop a short note in #release-notes and patch the PR with the checklist.
Dan: Great job everyone. :shipit:
